verdict.rationale: GitBook documents its own reader-facing GitBook Assistant. It can be embedded in docs, a website or a product, and it answers visitor questions using your content, with AI insights tracking how well it responds. The evidence never says the answers include citations or links back into specific pages, which is a required part of this story. Missing for 10: documented citations/source links in assistant answers, depth of docs on embedding and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an embedded AI assistant on my docs site answers reader questions with citations into my content

citations.quote: Add it to your product, website, or docs to give every user accurate, contextual answers.
AI insights shows what your visitors are asking and how effectively GitBook Assistant responds using your content.
I'm here to help you with the docs.
